title: Cute but expensive for the quantity and quality.
text: Cute but expensive for the quantity and quality.. Fit my cocomelon themed party perfectly,  but it's not much for the price. I had to supplement red and green supplies from Walmart for much cheaper and better quality. Could have at least come with cups and utensils for the price.

product_metadata.title: Creative Converting Fresh Watermelon Dinnerware Bundle for 8 - Dinner & Dessert Plates, 16 Luncheon & Beverage Napkins - Summer Party Supplies Birthday Decoration, Bulk Paper Disposable Set Partyware

DISPOSABLE DINNER & DESSERT PAPER PLATES - This party dinnerware bundle comes with 8 dinner plates (9") and 8 dessert plates (7") .

JUICY LUNCHEON & BEVERAGE PAPER NAPKINS - This bulk supply bundle comes with 16 luncheon napkins (6.5") and 16 beverage napkins (5") featuring vivid graphics of watermelons. Use at 4th of July parties, the beach, pool party, birthdays, Father's Day and more.
